title:
A whole orchard.
One clear view.
voice: Meet Demeter. A spatial design studio that turns orchard planning into a landscape you can explore.

title:
Every slope
changes the plan.
voice: On a hillside, water, sunlight, structures and operating costs are connected. Demeter brings those decisions into one computed, three dimensional orchard.

title:
Describe it.
Build from it.
voice: Start with a request. A one hundred sixty by ninety metre orchard. Twelve metres of elevation change. Two greenhouses, winter sunlight, and a four metre drone swath. Structured instructions update the design.

title:
Watch the
plan take shape.
voice: The same scene data drives geometry and engineering. Terrain is reconstructed along terrace boundaries. One hundred eighty eight trees grow into place. Foundations, columns and roof panels assemble. Finally, the water network extends from the source through the orchard. Each structure has a place. Every parameter has a consequence.

title:
Give growth
room to thrive.
voice: Greenhouse placement follows the available terraces. The design checks the building footprint, ground variation and separation from obstacles. Two protective structures become part of the orchard, with their own light transmission and construction costs.

title:
See the light.
Read the shade.
voice: Move through the solar day. Terrain ray tests estimate direct sunlight at each tree, while roof transmission changes the protected growing conditions. Compare locations before committing to a layout.

title:
Water, with
a working plan.
voice: The hydraulic engine evaluates one hundred eight configurations of routes, pipe sizes, pumps and watering zones. Fifty eight satisfy this scenario's constraints. Compare cost, pressure and operating time, then inspect a balanced design in three dimensions.

title:
A path through
the possibilities.
voice: Drone sweeps stay within the working area. Transfer paths route around structures, with spraying switched off between working segments. This plan achieves ninety seven point three percent geometric coverage.

title:
A design you
can compare.
voice: Bring investment and annual operations into the same decision. Adjust price and yield, compare cash flow and five year net present value, and export the design with its inputs and calculation results.

title:
Intent to tools.
Tools to terrain.
voice: The planner proposes structured edits. Validation preserves engineering constraints. The solver supplies the results. The model adapter uses this same contract, so the visual experience and the calculation pipeline stay connected.

title:
Shape the land.
See what grows.
voice: Demeter. From a hillside to an orchard you can understand. Explore the source, run the project, and build your next design.
